newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy household confidence falls again in April.
newsitem.headline: Italy household confidence falls again in April.

text.p: Confidence in the economy among Italian households slipped further in April, economic research institute Isco said in its latest monthly survey.
Isco's April confidence index (1980=100) fell to 108.1 from 108.6 in March and against 108.8 in April last year.

The survey showed growing overall pessimism accompanied by greater worries over the job market even though on a personal level those polled expressed "slightly more favourable" opinions about their own economic situation, Isco said.

The scenario for short-term buying intentions was slightly less gloomy with more people aiming to buy a new car, thanks to the government's current incentive scheme to scrap old cars, but over the next 12 months there were fewer planning to purchase durable goods and new homes, Isco said.
